traits.name: Icy Deflection
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The ice yai is targeted by a ranged Strike or spell attack roll that doesn't have the fire trait Effect The ice yai creates a reflective blockade of ice, gaining a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack roll. If the attack misses, the ice yai redirects the attack to another creature within 20 feet of the yai. The attacker rerolls the attack roll against the new target.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text: ⬻ (concentrate, polymorph, primal, transmutation); The ice yai takes on the appearance of an frost giant. This doesn't change their Speed or Strike attack and damage.

traits.name: Double Punch
traits.text: ⬻ Frequency once per round Effect The ice yai makes two fist Strikes.

traits.name: Frozen Strike
traits.text: On a critical hit with a fist Strike or a hit with an ice missile Strike, the target creature must attempt a DC 33 Fortitude save. Critical Success The creature is unaffected. Success The creature is slowed 1 for 1 round. Failure The creature is slowed 2 for 1 round. Critical Failure The creature is slowed 3 for 1 round.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fist +27 (agile, evil, magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 2d8+16 (2d8+16) bludgeoning plus 2d6 (2d6) cold and frozen strike

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ ice missile +25 (cold, evil, magical, range increment 60 feet); Damage 2d10+12 (2d10+12) cold and frozen strike
